# AxiomLint Four-Session Briefs Masterbook

Full individual session briefs for all 36 work packages: 144 proposed sessions.
This is a planning document, not execution, approval or closure evidence.
Planning baseline: `083f21c4b12a60c8556138d26d0aee516eb24d2b`. Read the protocol before selecting a session.

## Planning protocol

### Four-session planning protocol

Status: DRAFT planning supplement. This document expands the existing method;
it does not ratify the charter, activate a package, close S1, or authorize an
audit, experiment, installation, hosted check, network call or publication.
Only the live state records and actual human approvals can do that.

#### Stable sequence and authority

Each WP has four separately addressable briefs: S1 implementation, S2
independent read-only audit, S3 finding-only remediation, S4 documentation and
closure. Do not skip, merge or reorder them. One package is active at a time.
Four distinct session records and session-summary commits are mandatory even
when a session has no product delta. A stage may contain multiple work commits
and audit rounds; that does not make those rounds substitute sessions.

The dependency rule is the existing declaration's rule, not a new scheduling
decision. Normally finish WP-N S4 before WP-(N+1) S1. A dependency waiver, split,
reorder or additional correction package needs an actual approved amendment.
All briefs remain DRAFT_NOT_AUTHORIZED. The four existing WP-001 live session
records are not replaced with 144 invented executions.

WP-001 S1 is already open. Its S1 brief supplements remaining adoption work;
do not rerun history, discard the original commits or fabricate an earlier
approved entry. DEV-001, DEV-002, AMD-001 and FIND-S1-001 retain their actual state.

#### Entry and exit discipline

- **S1:** actual declaration approval, closed dependencies or explicit approved
  waiver, scoped file/test inventory, pinned entry head and reference-availability
  probe. Reproduce baseline, implement with positive/negative tests, preserve
  failed attempts, run local gates, commit handoff and provisionally met criteria.
- **S2:** S1 exit evidence exists; a genuinely separate reviewer/context reads the
  governing contract before the diff. Reviewed source, tests, schemas and contract
  stay read-only. Write logs/audit artifacts separately, pin reviewed head, inspect
  actual changes and independently reproduce outcomes. Commit only audit records.
- **S3:** committed S2 report; work only on actual finding IDs in D1-D4 order.
  Verify regressions fail pre-fix for the intended reason and pass post-fix.
  Independent delta re-audit rounds occur within S3, with separate reviewer and
  artifact identity. If there are no findings, independently verify and commit
  a no-change closure table anyway. Do not invent findings to fill a template.
- **S4:** clean independent delta audit, all required evidence and real approvals.
  Complete documentation, ledgers, traceability and rollback; run applicable
  local acceptance on the exact candidate. Only actual approved closure permits
  a following package to activate.

D1 forces FAIL and blocks unrelated work. D1/D2 cannot be carried. D3/D4 carry
needs actual authority, owner, bounded scope, expiry and compensating controls.
A reported false positive may be declined only with reproducible rationale and
independent/authorized disposition; an agent cannot waive its own audit findings.

#### Local-only verification and source identity

No hosted CI, pushes, hosted scans or remote runners. AMD-001 must be ratified
before local checks become authoritative acceptance; until then they are
development evidence. Historical plan clauses requiring hosted CI remain in
the original declaration but must never be executed by following a brief.

The known working baseline command is `python3 tools/local_check.py`. The
nonempty per-package command is `python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-NNN`; it
intentionally fails until S1 creates a package-specific executable suite.
The current full suite is not a substitute for later backend/security/science
tests. Declare all additional commands and pinned local materials before use.
Missing tools, incomplete test selection or deferred mandatory checks block
that package's closure, not just a line in a summary.

Run `--require-clean` only after committing the candidate. Record commit,
dirty state, exact source identity, schema/tool/environment identities and raw
log digests; independently verify saved artifacts. A local clean replay is not
another reviewer, signed provenance or a hostile-host security guarantee.
No provisioning/download/host installation happens during tests. Obtain
separate approval before changing the host or acquiring required materials.

Do not manufacture a commit's hash inside itself. Prepare and commit a candidate,
run clean checks, and obtain a real approval bound to its commit and manifest.
If a later closure/docs record changes the head, verify that head separately;
its evidence is not inherited from the candidate. Preserve final approvals as
durable externally bound records where needed to avoid infinite self-reference.
If the current governance schema cannot represent that distinction without
invented hashes or a circular acceptance claim, open a finding and block closure
until the method/schema is legitimately amended.

#### Execution and sensitive-action boundaries

Current subject execution and backends remain disabled. Future dynamic checks
need accepted WP-006 containment and the authorized capability policy. WP-006
itself needs staged independent containment-design review before dangerous
qualification tests; missing controls mean refusal, not naked-host experiments.
S2 may execute trusted verifier/tests through approved containment but cannot
alter the reviewed product source or bypass limits.

Local model service access is explicitly configured and authorized, never a
silent external fallback. Optional commercial/remote comparison arms need
separate charter/privacy/budget permission and remain outside the default plan.
Signing-key access, publication, pushing and release distribution are separately
authorized consequential actions, not consequences of drafting or closing a brief.

#### Experiment checkpoints inside the four sessions

EXP-E0 authorization, EXP-E1 preregistration and independent EXP-E2 protocol
review must precede EXP-E3 data generation. For WP-030 through WP-033, S1 may
contain those preparatory checkpoints and only then frozen-protocol execution
and registered analysis. EXP-E2 is a real independent pre-execution review,
not the later S2 audit and not a fifth lifecycle session. Without it, S1 stops.

S2 independently audits protocol chronology, measurement, scorer and analysis;
S3 corrects reported defects without moving thresholds, seeds, denominators or
exclusions after results. A flaw needing new data requires a separately
authorized experiment/correction cycle; do not call retry-until-pass remediation.
S4 carries human result acceptance (EXP-E5) and appropriately scoped synthesis
(EXP-E6), preserving null, negative, unexpected and inconclusive results.
Cross-campaign synthesis closes only when the relevant campaigns actually finish.

Pilots are distinct exploratory experiments with their own preregistration and
independent review before their data exists. Pilot variance may inform a later
confirmatory protocol, but pilot tasks/outcomes cannot become untouched holdouts.
Never prefill statistical thresholds with convenient invented values.

#### Dependency decisions that need approval

- **WP-025 calibration:** the original order places calibration before corpus
  governance. Either approve a separately licensed, independently labeled
  calibration dataset within WP-025, disjoint from all future confirmatory
  holdouts, or approve a scope/order/split amendment. An uncalibrated fallback
  preserves honest behavior but cannot silently satisfy a calibrated G5 gate.
- **WP-004 provisioning:** host installs and acquisition are not authorized by
  a session brief. Missing Nix/OCI/tool dependencies remain explicit entry blocks
  until separately approved local provisioning.
- **WP-032 remote arms:** default scope is local matched systems. Remote/API
  comparisons require a separate explicit amendment and privacy decision.
- **WP-036 release:** local candidate acceptance is not permission to publish.
  No hosted-check requirement reappears during release.

#### Brief revisions and actual records

The catalogue binds each brief, its package contract and the generator/profile/
protocol inputs by digest. Contract changes require reviewed rebaselining.
Live progress belongs in actual execution records, not generated DRAFT plans.
Freeze the chosen approved brief revision at activation; preserve it if later
planning changes supersede the catalogue. Never regenerate accepted history in
place. The renderer refuses to overwrite an existing catalogue; revision
handling must be deliberate and reviewed, not an automatic formatting step.

## WP-001 S1: Implementation

Work package: Charter and authority. Brief ID: `BRIEF-WP-001-S1`.
Brief status: `DRAFT_NOT_AUTHORIZED`; actual execution status is maintained
separately and is not changed by this file. Entry revision, owner/context,
approval evidence and reviewed head must be filled from reality at activation.
Role: Approved implementer; does not self-approve entry, audit or closure. Activity boundary: `IMPLEMENT_WITH_TESTS`.

Planning baseline: `083f21c4b12a60c8556138d26d0aee516eb24d2b`. Package declaration:
`governance/work-packages/WP-001.md`. Governing seed requirements: REQ-GOV-001, REQ-GOV-002, REQ-GOV-003, REQ-LIC-001.
Dependency closures: none; bootstrap authority still requires resolution.
Previous planned session: none. Next planned session: [WP-001-S2](#wp-001-s2-independent-audit).

### Authority read

Read `governance/charter/CHARTER.md`, `governance/charter/AMD-001-local-only.md`,
`governance/STATE.md`, this package declaration, its requirement sources and
`governance/standards/methodology.md`, evidence/security/testing standards.
Then read `governance/session-briefs/PROTOCOL.md` and
`docs/research/session-brief-design.md`. Authority conflicts stop affected work.
The live `governance/sessions/index.json` is not replaced by the draft catalogue.

WP-001 S1 already exists: supplement remaining adoption work and preserve its original commits/records. Do not reset history or infer approval from this new brief.

### Entry gates

- Read the actual declaration, requirements, current state, open findings/deferrals and approval records before the diff or implementation summary.
- Record the entry branch/head, exact source fingerprint, clean/intentionally dirty state, owner/context and baseline tool/material availability; placeholders must be resolved before work.
- Confirm no hosted test, push, installation, remote fallback, credential access or publication is implicitly authorized.
- Require an actually approved file-level declaration and closed dependencies or explicit approved waiver; WP-001's historical bootstrap exception must be separately resolved.
- Reproduce the pre-change baseline and agree package acceptance/test inventory before implementation; drafting this brief is not approved S1 entry.

### Scope and non-goals

Objective: Establish the project charter, scope, assurance vocabulary, decision rights, licensing policy, and authority hierarchy.
Stage scope: Implementation; operate only within its activity boundary.
Proposed file/subsystem scope: `governance/charter/`, `governance/standards/`, `governance/decisions/`, `governance/registers/`, `governance/work-packages/WP-001.md`.
These are planned locations, not claims those files/capabilities already exist.

No unrelated feature work, new language/repository-scale analysis, automatic
patching/repair, invented approvals, cross-stage shortcuts, hosted checks,
pushes or publication. S2 does not modify product code; S3 does not implement
unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Reconcile the existing S1 scaffold against the original constitution-only scope; inventory every prior implementation commit and preserve DEV-001 rather than recreating a clean historical entry.
- Complete the charter's decision-rights matrix, authority precedence, PyRS-first scope, FOSS baseline, claim glossary and prohibited assurance language.
- Present AMD-001 and the bootstrap deviation to Michael for actual ratification bound to document digests; unresolved decisions remain pending.
- Define reviewer/context independence, amendment and waiver authority, release authority, permanent retention and the single-active-package rule.
- Link all required decision/risk/assumption/finding/session registers and prove that unsupported approvals, stage skipping and premature closure fail validation.
- Implement in small coherent increments with executable positive, negative and inconclusive-path tests; keep raw failed attempts and reference-availability disposition.
- Run the package-specific nonempty suite and full local gate; pin implementation and handoff in an S1-specific commit without claiming independent S2.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-001/S1/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-001/S1/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/charter/CHARTER.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/charter/AMD-001-local-only.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/decisions/authority-map.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/standards/claim-glossary.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/registers/deviations.json`.
- `tests/test_wp_001_*.py`: approved package-specific executable acceptance coverage, not empty placeholder tests.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Approved charter; authority map; license policy; claim glossary; amendment and exception rules; initialized decision/risk/finding/session registers; governance validator passing.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-001-AC-01`: Positive: a correctly authorized draft has exactly one active package and valid authority references.
- `WP-001-AC-02`: Negative: missing approval evidence, self-audit, reused session commits and S2-before-S1 are rejected.
- `WP-001-AC-03`: Integrity: source baseline changes and tampered evidence cannot inherit previous acceptance.
- `WP-001-AC-04`: Scope: all scaffold exceptions and local-only overrides have explicit, nonfabricated dispositions.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-001
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_001_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Retroactive ratification masquerading as historical approval
- Closing a constitutional package while its foundational authority conflict is open

### Exit gates

- Approved scope implemented and original acceptance provisionally demonstrated by nonempty targeted tests plus full local gates.
- Source/material identities, raw artifacts, outstanding limits and truthful handoff are preserved; implementation pinned by its own S1 commit.
- No claim of independent audit, package closure or earned evidence tier follows automatically.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Revert charter adoption before dependent packages activate; once dependent work starts, supersede only by approved amendment.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S1, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-001-S2`.
The recipient must read the governing source, not accept this summary as authority.

### Technical reference reading

[Pinned four-session cycle](https://github.com/Symbo-gif/Methodology-Workflow-Governance/blob/d8d1d0d513bef6484cef587fc58ca3fa16fb4f2a/methodologies/work-package-session-cycle.md) [Pinned session-brief template](https://github.com/Symbo-gif/Methodology-Workflow-Governance/blob/d8d1d0d513bef6484cef587fc58ca3fa16fb4f2a/templates/session-brief.md)

These references inform proposed review tasks; pin actual executable versions
at authorized activation. No reference grants approval or reports a completed run.

- Confirm no hosted test, push, installation, remote fallback, credential access or publication is implicitly authorized.
- Require a committed S1 handoff, provisional acceptance evidence and exact reviewed S1 head.
- Use a genuinely independent reviewer/context that reads source directly. Keep product source, schemas, tests and governing contract read-only; logs/audit artifacts use separate writable locations.

### Scope and non-goals

Objective: Establish the project charter, scope, assurance vocabulary, decision rights, licensing policy, and authority hierarchy.
Stage scope: Independent audit; operate only within its activity boundary.
Proposed file/subsystem scope: `governance/charter/`, `governance/standards/`, `governance/decisions/`, `governance/registers/`, `governance/work-packages/WP-001.md`.
These are planned locations, not claims those files/capabilities already exist.

No unrelated feature work, new language/repository-scale analysis, automatic
patching/repair, invented approvals, cross-stage shortcuts, hosted checks,
pushes or publication. S2 does not modify product code; S3 does not implement
unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Check that no text converts the original build request into a signature, risk acceptance, independent review, or approval of later packages.
- Compare every bootstrap implementation and all new session plans with the constitution-only declaration; require an explicit scope disposition.
- Independently inspect FIND-S1-001, the source-fingerprint regression and raw retained runs, including the failed fixture run.
- Check AMD-001 against the upstream mandatory-CI conflict and verify that local evidence is not called hosted CI, signing or framework certification.
- Inventory actual changed files and compare scope, architecture, correctness, test validity, security, privacy, documentation, hygiene, evidence and prior obligations.
- Record each actual finding's unique ID, D1-D4, clause, exact location, failure mode, impact, reproduction/reasoning and expected remedy.
- Commit only audit artifacts with PASS, PASS-WITH-FINDINGS or FAIL. Any D1 forces FAIL; do not repair product source or self-ratify acceptance.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-001/S2/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-001/S2/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- `governance/audits/WP-001/S2-report.md`: independent identity, exact reviewed head, scope, reproduced evidence, limitations and verdict.
- `governance/audits/WP-001/S2-findings.json`: actual findings or an explicit empty set; never generated allegations.
- Product files listed in scope/deliverables are audit inputs, not permission for the reviewer to edit them.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Approved charter; authority map; license policy; claim glossary; amendment and exception rules; initialized decision/risk/finding/session registers; governance validator passing.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-001-AC-01`: Positive: a correctly authorized draft has exactly one active package and valid authority references.
- `WP-001-AC-02`: Negative: missing approval evidence, self-audit, reused session commits and S2-before-S1 are rejected.
- `WP-001-AC-03`: Integrity: source baseline changes and tampered evidence cannot inherit previous acceptance.
- `WP-001-AC-04`: Scope: all scaffold exceptions and local-only overrides have explicit, nonfabricated dispositions.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-001
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_001_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Retroactive ratification masquerading as historical approval
- Closing a constitutional package while its foundational authority conflict is open

### Exit gates

- Independent report and complete finding set committed with a real verdict and exact reviewed S1 head.
- Source read-only discipline, reproduction scope and unavailable checks documented; no hidden product fixes.
- S3 receives prioritized actual findings, including explicit no-findings/no-change requirement; a PASS is not S4 closure.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Revert charter adoption before dependent packages activate; once dependent work starts, supersede only by approved amendment.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S2, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-001-S3`.
The recipient must read the governing source, not accept this summary as authority.

- Run the package-specific nonempty suite and full local gate; pin implementation and handoff in an S1-specific commit without claiming independent S2.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-002/S1/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-002/S1/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/requirements/requirements.json`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/requirements/traceability.json`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `docs/assurance-case/standards-crosswalk.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `governance/requirements/ambiguity-review.md`.
- `tests/test_wp_002_*.py`: approved package-specific executable acceptance coverage, not empty placeholder tests.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Requirement register with source, rationale, verification method, owner, status, and bidirectional traceability; no orphan mandatory requirements; independent ambiguity audit.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-002-AC-01`: Positive: every mandatory clause has an owner, verification method and originating source.
- `WP-002-AC-02`: Negative: duplicate IDs, orphan evidence, nonexistent packages and missing reverse links fail.
- `WP-002-AC-03`: Semantic: deliberately ambiguous requirements are flagged for human resolution rather than inferred as approved.
- `WP-002-AC-04`: Change control: a replaced baseline retains its prior version and decision history.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-002
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_002_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Traceability completeness mistaken for implementation correctness
- A draft external standard silently promoted into a mandatory final baseline

### Exit gates

- Approved scope implemented and original acceptance provisionally demonstrated by nonempty targeted tests plus full local gates.
- Source/material identities, raw artifacts, outstanding limits and truthful handoff are preserved; implementation pinned by its own S1 commit.
- No claim of independent audit, package closure or earned evidence tier follows automatically.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Restore previous requirement baseline and retain rejected drafts.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S1, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-002-S2`.

but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.

downstream activation.

Work package: Threat model and trust case. Brief ID: `BRIEF-WP-003-S4`.
Brief status: `DRAFT_NOT_AUTHORIZED`; actual execution status is maintained
separately and is not changed by this file. Entry revision, owner/context,

Role: Documentation/closure owner; Michael is the actual human approver. Activity boundary: `HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`.

`governance/work-packages/WP-003.md`. Governing seed requirements: REQ-PRIV-001.
Dependency closures: WP-002.
Previous planned session: [WP-003-S3](#wp-003-s3-finding-only-remediation). Next planned session: [WP-004-S1](#wp-004-s1-implementation).

### Authority read

Read `governance/charter/CHARTER.md`, `governance/charter/AMD-001-local-only.md`,
`governance/STATE.md`, this package declaration, its requirement sources and
`governance/standards/methodology.md`, evidence/security/testing standards.
Then read `governance/session-briefs/PROTOCOL.md` and
`docs/research/session-brief-design.md`. Authority conflicts stop affected work.
The live `governance/sessions/index.json` is not replaced by the draft catalogue.

### Entry gates

- Read the actual declaration, requirements, current state, open findings/deferrals and approval records before the diff or implementation summary.
- Record the entry branch/head, exact source fingerprint, clean/intentionally dirty state, owner/context and baseline tool/material availability; placeholders must be resolved before work.
- Confirm no hosted test, push, installation, remote fallback, credential access or publication is implicitly authorized.
- Require completed S3 closure table, clean independent delta audit and all mandatory package-specific checks/evidence.
- Require actual charter/AMD-001 and scope approvals before authoritative closure; unresolved D1/D2 or missing criteria block entry.

### Scope and non-goals

Objective: Model threats from hostile source, compromised dependencies/tools, prompt injection, evidence tampering, semantic mistranslation, benchmark leakage, and malicious artifacts.
Stage scope: Documentation and closure; operate only within its activity boundary.
Proposed file/subsystem scope: `docs/assurance-case/`, `governance/registers/risks.json`, `governance/registers/tcb.json`, `governance/standards/security-and-privacy.md`.
These are planned locations, not claims those files/capabilities already exist.

No unrelated feature work, new language/repository-scale analysis, automatic
patching/repair, invented approvals, cross-stage shortcuts, hosted checks,
pushes or publication. S2 does not modify product code; S3 does not implement
unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Archive approved threat model, data flow, attack trees, TCB schema and risk decisions.
- Link mitigations to requirements and future test-owning packages and preserve all deferred controls.
- Assess G0 only after WP-001 through WP-003 independently close; no execution authority follows from G0 alone.
- Update directory/API/user docs, examples/migrations where affected, changelog, requirements, risks, decisions, evidence and session/package state records.
- Commit a candidate, run clean exact-revision local acceptance and verify raw evidence. Do not put a commit's own unknown hash inside itself or reuse older logs for a newer head.
- Obtain real maintainer approval; verify any later closure-record commit separately and preserve externally bound final attestations as required by PROTOCOL.md.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-003/S4/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-003/S4/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- `governance/closures/WP-003.md`: original criteria-to-evidence, four distinct session commits, audit/delta verdicts, findings and real approval references.
- `governance/state-reports/WP-003-S4.md`: exact accepted candidate/closure identities, residual limits, rollback and next declared package.
- Final local run manifest/schema/raw logs and independently checked approval binding; no fabricated CLOSED state, signature or external acceptance.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Threat model; attack-tree/data-flow diagrams; TCB manifest schema; mapped mitigations/tests; approved residual-risk register.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-003-AC-01`: Positive: a bounded claim identifies all relied-on TCB components and mitigation owners.
- `WP-003-AC-02`: Negative: missing trust edges, unapproved residual risks and unsupported security claims block acceptance.
- `WP-003-AC-03`: Adversarial design review: prompt injection and forged artifact metadata cannot grant authority.
- `WP-003-AC-04`: Privacy: environment capture excludes credentials and restricted source is not copied into public evidence.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-003
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_003_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Paper mitigations mistaken for running security controls
- Same-user host or benchmark scorer omitted from the trust case

### Exit gates

- All original acceptance criteria and mandatory package checks have exact evidence; docs/traceability/registers are complete.
- Four distinct session records/summary commits and independent S2/S3-delta evidence exist; actual human approvals bind the exact final acceptance scope.
- Only then mark the live package CLOSED and propose/activate its approved successor. Missing acceptance, ratification, risk or platform evidence means BLOCKED, not conditional success.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Disable all execution and remote-model adapters, retaining static-only analysis.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S4, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-004-S1`.

- Record the entry branch/head, exact source fingerprint, clean/intentionally dirty state, owner/context and baseline tool/material availability; placeholders must be resolved before work.
- Confirm no hosted test, push, installation, remote fallback, credential access or publication is implicitly authorized.
- Require the committed independent S2 report and a complete ordered finding set, including an explicitly empty set when appropriate.
- Lock change scope to actual finding IDs and approved dispositions; no features, refactors or hypothetical fixes merely because they appear below.

### Scope and non-goals

Objective: Create deterministic development, test, and release environments.
Stage scope: Finding-only remediation; operate only within its activity boundary.
Proposed file/subsystem scope: `pyproject.toml`, `environments/`, `flake.nix`, `flake.lock`, `uv.lock`, `Containerfile`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `docs/user-guide/`.
These are planned locations, not claims those files/capabilities already exist.

No unrelated feature work, new language/repository-scale analysis, automatic
patching/repair, invented approvals, cross-stage shortcuts, hosted checks,
pushes or publication. S2 does not modify product code; S3 does not implement
unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Fix only reported floating pins, missing offline materials or platform/install failures.
- Reproduce the pre-fix failure with caches disabled as declared; never hide a missing dependency behind the developer environment.
- Update lock/environment change evidence and re-audit affected licenses and reproducibility.
- Treat the package-specific remediation cases above as conditional categories, not invented findings. First reproduce the actual S2 issue and prove the regression fails pre-fix for the intended reason.
- Fix D1-D4 in order; link every change/test to its finding. Amendment/decline/carry decisions need actual authorized independent evidence; D1/D2 cannot be carried.
- Repeat targeted checks, full local gate and independent delta re-audit within S3 until clean. If no findings exist, commit an independently verified no-change closure table.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-004/S3/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-004/S3/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- `governance/findings/WP-004/closure-table.md`: every finding, disposition, fix/amendment/rejection/carry authority, regression and independent verification.
- `governance/audits/WP-004/S3-delta-review.md`: separate reviewer/context and exact remediated head per round, including no-change verification when empty.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Fresh Linux clone reproduces tool versions and test result; Windows compatibility documented and exercised where supported; environment manifest and SBOM generated; no undeclared network dependency during tests.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-004-AC-01`: Positive: fresh local checkout builds and runs with locked, prefetched tools.
- `WP-004-AC-02`: Negative: unavailable dependencies, altered lock digest and unsupported platform refuse acceptance.
- `WP-004-AC-03`: Network: tests make no resolver, image-pull or external service call.
- `WP-004-AC-04`: Reproduction: environment manifest and produced artifact digests link to the exact reviewed revision.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-004
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_004_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Local cache masking undeclared dependencies
- Hosted assurance or sandbox guarantees inferred from an OCI/Nix file

### Exit gates

- Every finding independently verified fixed, explicitly approved amended/declined, or validly carried under policy; no unresolved D1/D2.
- Regression and complete local evidence exist, independent delta review is clean, and closure table has its own S3 commit.
- Even an empty finding set has independent no-change verification; S4 cannot be skipped.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Restore last pinned lock/environment definitions.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S3, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-004-S4`.
The recipient must read the governing source, not accept this summary as authority.

- `governance/audits/WP-005/S2-report.md`: independent identity, exact reviewed head, scope, reproduced evidence, limitations and verdict.
- `governance/audits/WP-005/S2-findings.json`: actual findings or an explicit empty set; never generated allegations.
- Product files listed in scope/deliverables are audit inputs, not permission for the reviewer to edit them.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Positive/negative schema fixtures; stable IDs; canonical serialization; SHA-256 verification; migration/version policy; corruption tests fail closed.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-005-AC-01`: Positive: all record types and graph references validate against pinned schemas.
- `WP-005-AC-02`: Negative: malformed, extra-key, duplicate-key, wrong-type and nonfinite fixtures fail closed.
- `WP-005-AC-03`: Integrity: corruption, missing objects, interrupted writes and symlinks never become success.
- `WP-005-AC-04`: Migration: prior accepted artifacts remain unchanged and are read through explicit version adapters.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-005
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_005_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Syntactic schema validity mistaken for authorized evidence
- Partial-write recovery overwriting or laundering historical evidence

### Exit gates

- Independent report and complete finding set committed with a real verdict and exact reviewed S1 head.
- Source read-only discipline, reproduction scope and unavailable checks documented; no hidden product fixes.
- S3 receives prioritized actual findings, including explicit no-findings/no-change requirement; a PASS is not S4 closure.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Read-only compatibility adapter to the prior schema; never rewrite accepted evidence in place.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S2, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-005-S3`.

### Scope and non-goals

unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Define accepted repository/commit/diff/directory modes and pin source Git identity, dirty state, file digests and reviewed patch.
- Implement safe file classification and path handling for Unicode, renames, deleted lines, generated files, symlinks and submodules.
- Add AST/CST parsing and source-to-diff location mapping without importing reviewed code.
- Distinguish syntax error, unsupported file/semantics and incomplete intake from a clean review.
- Seed a bounded dependency graph and document language/subset limits before any interprocedural claim.
- Implement in small coherent increments with executable positive, negative and inconclusive-path tests; keep raw failed attempts and reference-availability disposition.
- Run the package-specific nonempty suite and full local gate; pin implementation and handoff in an S1-specific commit without claiming independent S2.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-007/S1/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-007/S1/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- Proposed product deliverable: `src/axiomlint/intake/`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `docs/architecture/intake.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `docs/supported-semantics/intake-matrix.md`.
- Proposed product deliverable: `tests/conformance/intake/`.
- `tests/test_wp_007_*.py`: approved package-specific executable acceptance coverage, not empty placeholder tests.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Fixtures for renames, deleted lines, syntax errors, generated files, symlinks, submodules, dirty trees, and Unicode paths; exact reviewed SHA appears in every artifact.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-007-AC-01`: Positive: the same pinned source/diff yields stable file and line identities.
- `WP-007-AC-02`: Negative: dirty/stale source, syntax failure and unsupported modes preserve distinct states.
- `WP-007-AC-03`: Path safety: traversal, symlinks, submodules and Unicode do not silently change reviewed content.
- `WP-007-AC-04`: Nonexecution: top-level subject side effects remain unexecuted during intake.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-007
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.

versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

- Syntax recognition confused with semantic support

- Source/material identities, raw artifacts, outstanding limits and truthful handoff are preserved; implementation pinned by its own S1 commit.

but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.

downstream activation.

- Treat the package-specific remediation cases above as conditional categories, not invented findings. First reproduce the actual S2 issue and prove the regression fails pre-fix for the intended reason.
- Fix D1-D4 in order; link every change/test to its finding. Amendment/decline/carry decisions need actual authorized independent evidence; D1/D2 cannot be carried.
- Repeat targeted checks, full local gate and independent delta re-audit within S3 until clean. If no findings exist, commit an independently verified no-change closure table.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-009/S3/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-009/S3/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- `governance/findings/WP-009/closure-table.md`: every finding, disposition, fix/amendment/rejection/carry authority, regression and independent verification.
- `governance/audits/WP-009/S3-delta-review.md`: separate reviewer/context and exact remediated head per round, including no-change verification when empty.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Stable output ordering; reversible links to raw evidence; contradictory findings represented; SARIF validates; reporter snapshots deterministic.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-009-AC-01`: Positive: deterministic JSON/Markdown/SARIF with reversible raw-evidence links.
- `WP-009-AC-02`: Negative: conflicting evidence, failed invocations and invalid schemas cannot appear clean.
- `WP-009-AC-03`: Deduplication: collisions and order permutations retain distinct source failures as needed.
- `WP-009-AC-04`: Suppression: expired/unapproved waivers cannot remove blocking findings.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-009
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_009_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Lossy fusion making corroboration appear stronger than it is
- SARIF validity confused with proof or scan completeness

### Exit gates

- Every finding independently verified fixed, explicitly approved amended/declined, or validly carried under policy; no unresolved D1/D2.
- Regression and complete local evidence exist, independent delta review is clean, and closure table has its own S3 commit.
- Even an empty finding set has independent no-change verification; S4 cannot be skipped.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Emit unfused per-tool reports plus native evidence.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S3, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-009-S4`.
The recipient must read the governing source, not accept this summary as authority.

Dependency closures: WP-010.
Previous planned session: [WP-011-S1](#wp-011-s1-implementation). Next planned session: [WP-011-S3](#wp-011-s3-finding-only-remediation).

### Authority read

Read `governance/charter/CHARTER.md`, `governance/charter/AMD-001-local-only.md`,
`governance/STATE.md`, this package declaration, its requirement sources and
`governance/standards/methodology.md`, evidence/security/testing standards.
Then read `governance/session-briefs/PROTOCOL.md` and
`docs/research/session-brief-design.md`. Authority conflicts stop affected work.
The live `governance/sessions/index.json` is not replaced by the draft catalogue.

### Entry gates

- Read the actual declaration, requirements, current state, open findings/deferrals and approval records before the diff or implementation summary.
- Record the entry branch/head, exact source fingerprint, clean/intentionally dirty state, owner/context and baseline tool/material availability; placeholders must be resolved before work.
- Confirm no hosted test, push, installation, remote fallback, credential access or publication is implicitly authorized.
- Require a committed S1 handoff, provisional acceptance evidence and exact reviewed S1 head.
- Use a genuinely independent reviewer/context that reads source directly. Keep product source, schemas, tests and governing contract read-only; logs/audit artifacts use separate writable locations.

### Scope and non-goals

Objective: Turn specifications and findings into minimized executable counterexamples and measure test adequacy.
Stage scope: Independent audit; operate only within its activity boundary.
Proposed file/subsystem scope: `src/axiomlint/backends/hypothesis/`, `src/axiomlint/specir/`, `tests/conformance/`, `docs/user-guide/counterexamples.md`.
These are planned locations, not claims those files/capabilities already exist.

No unrelated feature work, new language/repository-scale analysis, automatic
patching/repair, invented approvals, cross-stage shortcuts, hosted checks,
pushes or publication. S2 does not modify product code; S3 does not implement
unreported improvements; S4 does not hide a product fix in documentation.

### Required actions

- Replay saved inputs with the example database absent and a changed search seed.
- Check minimized-input claims and avoid claiming global minimality from ordinary shrinking.
- Inspect independence of the property/oracle from any generator of the finding.
- Verify mutation statistics retain invalid/equivalent cases and are not presented as correctness proof.
- Inventory actual changed files and compare scope, architecture, correctness, test validity, security, privacy, documentation, hygiene, evidence and prior obligations.
- Record each actual finding's unique ID, D1-D4, clause, exact location, failure mode, impact, reproduction/reasoning and expected remedy.
- Commit only audit artifacts with PASS, PASS-WITH-FINDINGS or FAIL. Any D1 forces FAIL; do not repair product source or self-ratify acceptance.

### Required artefacts

- `governance/execution/WP-011/S2/record.json`: actual owner/context, entry/reviewed/exit revisions, dirty/source identities, decisions and evidence links; create only at authorized activation.
- `governance/execution/WP-011/S2/handoff.md`: changed/examined files, criteria, command outcomes, limitations, outstanding obligations and next-stage decision.
- Raw local stdout/stderr, command inventory, pinned environment/tool/schema identities, artifact sizes/digests and failed/inconclusive outcomes; redact secrets without destroying restricted originals.
- `governance/audits/WP-011/S2-report.md`: independent identity, exact reviewed head, scope, reproduced evidence, limitations and verdict.
- `governance/audits/WP-011/S2-findings.json`: actual findings or an explicit empty set; never generated allegations.
- Product files listed in scope/deliverables are audit inputs, not permission for the reviewer to edit them.

### Acceptance and verification matrix

Original declaration acceptance retained verbatim as source baseline:

> Seed-independent replay from saved examples; minimized inputs; pre-fix failure/post-fix pass protocol; mutation results never presented as correctness proof.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable
instruction: the user's local-only constraint prevails, and AMD-001 ratification
is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-011-AC-01`: Positive: saved minimized inputs replay the declared failure without search.
- `WP-011-AC-02`: Negative: changed spec/source/oracle and serialization mismatch invalidate prior replay.
- `WP-011-AC-03`: Independence: absent cache and changed seed do not prevent concrete-input replay.
- `WP-011-AC-04`: Mutation: denominators and equivalent/invalid mutants remain visible and bounded.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py
python3 tools/run_wp_tests.py WP-011
python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.
S1 must create `tests/test_wp_011_*.py` before claiming targeted acceptance;
do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
Before work, declare additional package-specific invocation/replay commands,
versions and test fixtures implementing the matrix; baseline checks alone do
not exercise future solvers, proofs, sandbox enforcement or statistical validity.

After the relevant candidate is committed and ratification permits acceptance:

```sh
python3 tools/local_check.py --require-clean
python3 tools/verify_local_run.py artifacts/gates/RUN-ID --check-current-source
```

Use the printed real run ID. S2 verifies the reviewed S1 head; S3 verifies its
remediated head; S4 verifies its exact candidate and any later closure-record
head separately. Capture unsuccessful commands too. No command here provisions
tools, downloads data, starts a remote model, pushes or configures hosted CI.

### Scientific boundary

Engineering fixtures and this session plan are not comparative benchmark results.
No campaign, outcome inspection or effectiveness claim is authorized here.
If proposed work becomes a measurement campaign, stop and obtain EXP-E0/E1/E2
before its data exists; never relabel post-result choices as preregistered.

### Stop/block conditions

- Actual approval/dependency/independence missing; governing contracts conflict; source identity changes unexpectedly; mandatory checks are empty, unavailable or deferred.
- Any D1, unresolved D2, evidence corruption, privacy breach, invalid oracle, unsupported semantics or attempted unsupported assurance promotion.
- Execution without accepted containment, undeclared network/provisioning, hidden holdout access, or a request to retry until a favorable outcome.
- Seed or internal failure blob mistaken for a durable concrete counterexample
- Circular generated oracle laundered as independent evidence

### Exit gates

- Independent report and complete finding set committed with a real verdict and exact reviewed S1 head.
- Source read-only discipline, reproduction scope and unavailable checks documented; no hidden product fixes.
- S3 receives prioritized actual findings, including explicit no-findings/no-change requirement; a PASS is not S4 closure.

### Rollback and retention

Original package rollback: Preserve generated tests but disable automatic generation.
Disable/quarantine affected capability or restore the prior source baseline,
but retain raw observations, failed attempts, findings and historical approvals.
Accepted records are superseded through new records/errata, not rewritten.
For S2, rollback never authorizes a different stage's work or automatic
downstream activation.

### Handoff

Provide actual entry/reviewed/exit commits, distinct session-summary commit,
files changed/examined, original-clause/AC evidence map, exact commands and raw
digests, verdict/dispositions, residual risks and unavailable checks. Name the
next owner and independence requirement without inventing their identity or
approval. Successor: `WP-011-S3`.
The recipient must read the governing source, not accept this summary as authority.

### Technical reference reading

[Hypothesis replay API](https://hypothesis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/api.html) [Pinned four-session cycle](https://github.com/Symbo-gif/Methodology-Workflow-Governance/blob/d8d1d0d513bef6484cef587fc58ca3fa16fb4f2a/methodologies/work-package-session-cycle.md)

These references inform proposed review tasks; pin actual executable versions
at authorized activation. No reference grants approval or reports a completed run.

- Implement a model-to-source value decoder and reject unsupported or lossy conversions.
- Build conformance, metamorphic and deliberately wrong-translation fixtures with pinned source/spec/formula links.
- Implement in small coherent increments with executable positive, negative and inconclusive-path tests; keep raw failed attempts and reference-availability disposition.
- Run the package-specific nonempty suite and full local gate; pin implementation and handoff in an S1-specific commit without claiming independent S2.

> Translation conformance suite; hand-reviewed mappings; metamorphic tests; model-to-source value decoder; unsupported semantics rejected.

is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion
or claim it passed; record its approved local replacement.

Package-specific proposed acceptance obligations:

- `WP-013-AC-01`: Positive: hand-calculated source/spec cases emit expected bounded obligations.
- `WP-013-AC-02`: Negative: mismatched arithmetic, quantifiers, exceptional paths and unsupported syntax refuse translation.
- `WP-013-AC-03`: Metamorphic: semantics-preserving transformations preserve obligations within the declared model.
- `WP-013-AC-04`: Decoder: models round-trip to valid source-domain values without truncation or coercion loss.

evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4

> Translation conformance suite; hand-reviewed mappings; metamorphic tests; model-to-source value decoder; unsupported semantics rejected.

Any hosted/pushed-CI phrase in that historical clause is not an executable

is required for authoritative local closure. Do not erase the original criterion

- `WP-013-AC-02`: Negative: mismatched arithmetic, quantifiers, exceptional paths and unsupported syntax refuse translation.

All stage work checks these obligations from its own role: S1 constructs
evidence, S2 independently challenges it, S3 resolves actual defects and S4
traces accepted evidence to every clause. Structural validity is not authority.

### Verification commands

Run on the user's laptop, from the repository root, with approved local materials:

```sh
python3 tools/check_session_briefs.py

python3 tools/local_check.py
```

The targeted command intentionally fails on missing/empty/all-skipped coverage.

do not run all 36 future suites now or count an absent tool as a clean scan.
